2.text: Ni ukuri nkikijwe n'abakobanyi,Nta kindi mpora ndeba keretse abanshungera.

3.text: Noneho tanga ingwate unyishingire kuri wowe,Uwo twakorana mu biganza dusezerana ni nde?

4.text: Kuko imitima yabo wayihishe ubwenge,Ni cyo gituma utazabashyira ejuru.

5.text: Umuntu utanga incuti ze ngo zibe iminyago,Amaso y'abana be aziheba.

6.text: Ariko yangize iciro ry'imigani mu bantu,Kandi bancira mu maso.

7.text: Agahinda gateye ijisho ryanjye guhunyeza,N'ingingo zanjye zose zimeze nk'igicucu.

8.text: Ibyo bizatera inyangamugayo kūmirwa.Kandi utariho urubanza aziyenza ku batubaha Imana.

9.text: Ariko umukiranutsi azikomeza mu nzira ye,N'ufite amaboko aboneye azakomeza kunguka imbaraga.

10.text: Ariko mwebweho mwese nimugaruke muze,Nta munyabwenge n'umwe nabona muri mwe.

11.text: “Iminsi yanjye irashize,Imigambi umutima wanjye wibwiraga ipfuye ubusa.

13.text: Iyo ntegereje ikuzimu ko ari ho iwanjye,Iyo nshashe uburiri bwanjye mu mwijima.

14.text: Iyo mbwiye Kubora nti ‘Uri data’,Nkabwira n'inyo nti‘Uri mama kandi uri na mushiki wanjye’.

15.text: Noneho ibyiringiro byanjye biri he,Kandi ibyo byiringiro byanjye ni nde uzabibona?

16.text: Bizamanuka bigere ku myugariro y'ikuzimu,Ubwo nzaruhukanira na byo mu mukungugu.”
